parsed.reason: The comment itself concedes the behaviour is mostly harmless since upserts are idempotent, and the claim about reset_import deleting the row and restarting from page 0 is the intended reset semantics, not a defect. The next_page default of 0 on a fresh row matches checkpoint()'s own default of 0, so there is no wrong behaviour shown. At most this is a minor design observation.
